title: 刘爷爷看电视

title_tr.es: El abuelo Liu ve la tele

lines.py: xīng qī liù xià wǔ, Wáng Míng qù kàn Liú yé ye.
lines.en: On Saturday afternoon, Wang Ming goes to see Grandpa Liu.
